# Templates — your own situation plays

Two ways your saved plays become the base for everything else:

1. **In the app (no export):** open a saved play → **☆ Template**. It now shows under
   **＋ New play → start from a template** (copy opens in the editor) and as a personal audible
   under **⭐ My plays** in the ⚡ audible sheet and the editor palette.
2. **For review / to seed the shared library:** **⬆ Import ▾ → 💾 Backup all my plays** and drop
   the `.thplay.json` file into this folder. Files here are picked up when the sample library
   is regenerated; they are also importable on any device with ⬆ Import.

Nothing in this folder is loaded automatically by the app at runtime — it is the hand-over point.
